rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    // ── Global: Allow authenticated read/write ──
    // This resolves permission denied errors during login and real-time sync
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null;
    }

    // Keep public access for specific landing page items
    match /books/{bookId} { allow read: if true; }
    match /products/{productId} { allow read: if true; }
    match /packages/{packageId} { allow read: if true; }
    match /usernames/{username} { allow read: if true; }
  }
}
